title: Don't Become A Content Creator, Build A Content Business.
promo_conflict: Promotes her own newsletter, events, academy and Private Client programs

idea.name: Niche content business with a product ladder
idea.one_liner: Win one platform in a high-RPM niche (finance/business), then funnel free content into a newsletter, a low-ticket guide, and progressively higher rungs (courses/events, $500-5K cohorts, big-ticket services) rather than relying on ad revenue and sponsorships
idea.offer: free content, newsletter, books, courses, events, advisory
idea.revenue_model: product ladder plus sponsorships and ad revenue

key_quotes.quote: I like starting with free content and adding one paid step, a free newsletter that captures the relationship, plus a single low ticket guide as your first wrung, then you only add the other once the one below is full.
38% of tickets sold came from paid advertising, which means 62% came from organic.
So, at about 100,000 subscribers, a single YouTube sponsorship runs about 5k to 15k.

claims.claim: Paycheck investing video earned RPM $12.52 and ~$10K on 800K views
claims.quote: And it got about 800K views generating just over 10K of revenue.

claims.claim: 27% of event tickets sold via YouTube videos, 11% via YouTube community posts
claims.quote: And, you know, for our recent event, MSM Live, we sold 27% of our tickets through YouTube videos.

claims.claim: Over 2M TikTok followers sold under a dozen event tickets
claims.quote: To put this in perspective, I have over 2 million followers on the platform, and I've sold less than a dozen tickets to my last event.

acquisition_channels.details: YouTube long-form and community posts, Instagram carousels, LinkedIn quote posts, TikTok for awareness

ideas.delivery: swipe file of top 100 niche videos, comment mining, problem bank; analytics calibration per platform
ideas.other_uk_rules: CAP Code and CMA influencer rules require clear #ad labelling of sponsored posts

idea.name: Owned-audience business newsletter
idea.one_liner: Newsletter of frameworks, business breakdowns and deal analysis that is the highest-converting channel for selling events and products

key_quotes.quote: So, this one might not sound like social media, but it's the highest intent and value audience no one talks about.
But don't be fooled, you actually own this audience.

claims.claim: 30% of event tickets sold through the newsletter
claims.quote: So it's the channel you sell the most through. We sold 30% of our tickets through newsletter.

idea.name: Live business events sold via organic content
idea.one_liner: In-person business events (MSM Live) selling tickets mainly through newsletter, YouTube and Instagram rather than TikTok, X or LinkedIn

key_quotes.quote: In fact, I think we've sold 100x the tickets on Instagram that on TikTok for our last event.
Now for our last event, just over 1% of the tickets sold through social media came through X, which is basically none.

idea.name: Done-for-you business sourcing for individuals
idea.one_liner: Ultra-select Private Client program that sources small businesses for individuals to buy, at the top of a content product ladder
idea.customer: wealthy individuals wanting to acquire businesses

key_quotes.quote: And then now we have ultra-select programs called Private Client, where we actually source businesses for individuals.
